run_plot_benchmark: run the plot function to generate a horizontal bar chart PDF from FPS benchmark profile data files
build_bench_plot: build a benchmark plot by passing an OrderedDict of names and a base_name to the plot function
refactor_plot_function: refactor the plot function to accept a custom directory path instead of hardcoded data/profile/hab3
review_plot_function: review the plot function that reads FPS values from profile text files and generates a bar chart
summarize_plot_function: summarize the plot function that computes mean and standard error of FPS across multiple benchmark runs
